runs.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
runs.note: It stopped after 1,792 answers when the service reported the model at capacity, and was resumed for the other 406 questions; the usage and cost of the failed request are unknown.

runs.name: Grok 4.7
runs.note: xAI did not answer 31 attempts within the time limit, and the runner sent each such request again. The run stopped twice and was resumed from the last answered question: at 1,696 answers, after one request timed out six times (the limit then went from 15 to 30 minutes), and at 2,144, when a retry sent an expired sign-in token. The usage and cost of the timed-out attempts are unknown.

runs.name: vLLM-SR d3
runs.note: The vLLM Semantic Router's released Decision 3.0 checkpoint (vllm-sr/d3 at 20f37b9), fine-tuned from Qwen3.8-27B (Qwen3.5 architecture), served on our hardware through vLLM's System One endpoint by a nightly build (0.32.1rc1.dev613+g8977b13a1) with --max-num-seqs 256: with the default, vLLM's startup memory check did not fit the GPU. One request at a time, as for the other setups.
runs.access: vLLM System One endpoint (nightly), self-hosted, BF16

runs.name: vLLM-SR d3-ultra
runs.note: The vLLM Semantic Router's released d3-ultra checkpoint (vllm-sr/d3-ultra at 52ba9e7), fine-tuned from Qwen3.8-27B (Qwen3.5 architecture), served on our hardware through the server its repository ships (d3_server.py, the package's transformers runtime as in the model card's Quickstart; transformers 5.17.0). vLLM cannot serve it yet: it rejects the checkpoint's attention mode (prefix_bidir). One request at a time, as for the other setups.
runs.access: d3 package server (transformers, the release code), self-hosted, BF16

runs.name: OneJev 27B
runs.note: OmniJev's released OneJev checkpoint (OmniJev/OneJev-27B at a5e5f55), a full fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B that also reads images, served on our hardware through the server its package ships (qev 0.1.4, qev serve) with its defaults. One request at a time, as for the other setups. The five runs are identical because decoding is deterministic: each run sent all 2,198 questions again as separate requests.
